parameters.description: Filter tasks by tag (e.g. smoke, golden). Leave empty for all.
Filter by task_id (substring match). Leave empty for all.
Filter by model (e.g. sonnet). Leave empty for all.

let _filteredTasks = TaskResults
| join kind=inner (
    SmokeRuns
    | where start_time between (_startTime .. _endTime)
    | project run_id, run_start_time = start_time
  ) on run_id
| project-away run_id1
| where isempty(_tag) or tags has _tag
| where isempty(_taskId) or task_id has _taskId
| where isempty(_model) or model_used has _model;
_filteredTasks
| summarize avg_success_rate = round(100.0 * countif(status == 'SUCCESS') / count(), 1) by day = startofday(run_start_time)
| order by day asc

let _filteredTasks = TaskResults
| join kind=inner (

| where isempty(_tag) or tags has _tag
| where isempty(_taskId) or task_id has _taskId

_filteredTasks
| mv-expand tag = tags to typeof(string)
| summarize
    tasks = dcount(task_id),
    runs = count(),
    pass_rate = round(100.0 * countif(status == 'SUCCESS') / count(), 1),
    avg_score = round(avg(weighted_score), 3),
    avg_iterations = round(avg(iteration_count), 1),
    avg_latency_sec = round(avg(duration_seconds), 1),
    avg_assistant_turns = round(avg(todouble(total_assistant_turns)), 1),
    avg_commands = round(avg(todouble(total_commands)), 1),
    avg_cost_usd = round(avg(total_cost_usd), 5),
    total_cost_usd = round(sum(total_cost_usd), 4),
    avg_tokens = round(avg(todouble(total_tokens)), 0)
  by tag
| order by pass_rate asc
